description.zh: 游戏内调试面板（F1）：改装备与词缀、发资源、开团本 / 终焉 / 秘境 / 深渊的开关。护肝类 mod，改的是本机存档，联机时建议先关掉。
description.en: In-game debug console (F1): edit gear and affixes, grant resources, toggle raid / ultra / rift / abyss switches. A quality-of-life mod; it only touches your local save, turn it off before multiplayer.
